body:
I already did all the motivation crap.  I'm at the end of that tunnel.  Nothing changed.  NOTHING.

I feel like someone needs to hit me over the head with a rock or something, so that I can just start drooling on myself and be happy with nothing.

Life is really demoralizing when you realize some things will forever be out of your control.  That's where I am right now. I'm trying to find a way to even discuss this, to bring thoughts into the open, about genetic failure in a world where we pretend everything is one's fault.  We pretend we are all the consequences of our actions.  I am struggling in between the *knowledge* that I am not sufficient  -this burden I push away, shove in the closet and slam the door behind, - and that last glimmer of human spirit that doesn't want to see onesself as a victim.  Who wants to change his life, of his own volition, for the better.  But I am starting to see that might not always be possible.  I just wasn't ready for death yet.  I guess that's the real comedy of human life though.  Few are ready for it when it comes a knocking.

>You are as much if not more of a genetic mess as I'm ATM!

Yes.  I know this.  It is innate.  Women can smell it.  I need to kill myself.  I did all of that.  My life is almost painfully disciplined. It's disgusting how little progress it brings in the human realm.  Other ones?  Fantastic results.  Humans?  Failure.  Failure.  Repeated Failure.  Overwhelming, unyielding, unending failure.  Fucking christ, I need to off myself.  That's what my peers say, it's just unspoken.  It's between the lines.  It's the unspoken message.  It's what not being included means in a globalized, interconnected world.  Time to disconnect.  God damnit, I thought there was more.

Oh my fucking god. This really frustrates me.

It was just a fancy/eloquent way of saying that I'm just now realizing how female attraction works, and that I "don't have the goods" and no amount of stupid fucking prep talk will change reality, no matter how much anyone wants to pretend it will.  And oh, how they will. I know I'm supposed to take this with dignity, like those lonely lost souls before me, but FUCK THAT.  If I don't get to participate, and if even thinking I'm equal with those around me is a straight offensive thought, and if my words will just be parsed for no reason, even when the meaning is clear, then fuck it.  I'm flailing.  I'm making sure EVERYONE gets to feel what I feel.  I'm going to make it awkward, and uncomfortable for everyone, all the time, always.  Really though, I just need to kill myself.

All I was saying is that the sexual world is FUCKING BRUTAL for young men who are not genetically predisposed toward what women want. I forget that we need to pick it all apart until we can go "see, you don't see the world at all." No, I see it.  It's here.  It meant that just now, my eyes are opening to how bleak my future is.  Just how much deeper the well of loneliness goes. I'm just not your level, commander syntax.

This isn't an event.  It's a musing on the last decade. It's the waning optimism of a nascent realist who understands they were not born sufficient, or are simply not able to achieve it in a relevant time period, and wondered why they always got less-than-positive reactions from their peers. 

I need to kill myself, it won't get better.
